scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Hello~! I am a Cute Pet Manager
who is in charge of public relations
for the New Upgraded Cute Pet system.
scripts.translation:
[寵物管理員]
您好~！我是負責新版寵物系統宣傳事務的寵物管理員。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
If you have any concerns regarding
the Cute Pet system I am here to guide you.
Let me know which taming
item you want,
then I will tell you the monster
that you can tame with the item.
scripts.translation:
[寵物管理員]
如果您對寵物系統有疑問，我可以為您介紹。請告訴我想要哪種馴服道具，我會說明可以用它馴服哪些魔物。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Also I will explain what materials
you need to bring in order to
get the taming item.
scripts.translation:
[寵物管理員]
我還會告訴您兌換這種馴服道具需要準備哪些材料。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
If you already brought materials
to exchange for the taming item,
I can exchange it for taming items immediately.
scripts.translation:
[寵物管理員]
如果您已經帶齊兌換馴服道具所需的材料，我可以馬上為您兌換。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
However, there is a limit
for exchanging taming items.
You can only get taming items
{0} times. So please make sure
how many times you have exchanged.
scripts.translation:
[寵物管理員]
不過，馴服道具的兌換次數有限，最多隻能兌換{0}次。請確認自己已經兌換過幾次。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
So, which taming item do you want?
Please choose one from the list.
scripts.translation:
[寵物管理員]
那麼，您想要哪種馴服道具？
請從列表中選擇一項。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Ah, you have gathered all items
with your friends. You can now
exchange for an {0}.
Do you want to exchange with me?
scripts.translation:
[寵物管理員]
啊，您和朋友們已經集齊了所有材料，現在可以兌換{0}了。要和我兌換嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
You don't? You will come back again.
scripts.translation:
[寵物管理員]
您不想兌換嗎？之後還會再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Wise choice.
I hope you and your pet get along.
scripts.translation:
[寵物管理員]
明智的選擇。希望您和寵物相處愉快。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
You have chosen {0}.
You can use it for taming
^FF0000{1}^000000 monsters.
scripts.translation:
[寵物管理員]
您選擇了{0}。
可以用它馴服^FF0000{1}^000000種魔物。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Bring ^FF0000{0} {1}^000000{2} ^000000 and ^FF00001 Dolly Capsule^000000
then you can exchange them
for an {3}.
